explanation: RBI requires commercial banks to maintain a minimum CRAR of 9% (excluding buffers), which is 1% higher than the Basel minimum of 8%.
The three pillars of Basel III are Pillar 1 (Minimum Capital), Pillar 2 (Supervisory Review), and Pillar 3 (Market Discipline).
The RBI has mandated a minimum Capital to Risk-Weighted Assets Ratio (CRAR) of 9% for commercial banks.
